payload.instruction: Put a frog in the toilet
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Is a recognizable frog visibly situated within the toilet bowl, rather than merely on the lid, tank, rim, or floor?
node.criteria: Pass if a recognizable frog is visibly within the bowl opening/interior; fail if the bowl is assessable and no frog is within it, even if frogs appear elsewhere; unknown if the relevant placement cannot be assessed reliably. Report the observed location(s) and any ambiguity about whether the apparent frog is actually in the bowl.
node.binding: Compare the edited image with the source toilet. Localize the frog relative to the bowl interior, rim, lid, tank, and floor; do not mistake the pre-existing dark object in the source bowl for a frog. This is evidence of placement, not a completion judgment.

response.content: {"status":"pass","evidence":"The edited image shows a recognizable green frog inside the toilet bowl opening, seated within the bowl interior.
